- [MCP Tools](https://kotarotsubaki.github.io/ambercast/reference/mcp-tools/): Planned tool contracts, result classifications, and safety defaults for ambercast MCP workflows.
- [ambercast review](https://kotarotsubaki.github.io/ambercast/reference/cli/review/): Define the planned independent-AI review outcome and known flags for ambercast review.
- [ambercast mcp](https://kotarotsubaki.github.io/ambercast/reference/cli/mcp/): Server launch and transport discipline for the planned ambercast Model Context Protocol interface.
- [ambercast baseline and restore](https://kotarotsubaki.github.io/ambercast/reference/cli/baseline-restore/): Planned external database baseline capture and restore interface for ambercast.
- [MCP server](https://kotarotsubaki.github.io/ambercast/agents/mcp-server/): Planned connection boundary and status for the ambercast Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
